instr: Order: put the animals in a row so that every sentence is true.
clue: Read the sentences, then put each animal in one of the numbered places so that all the sentences are true. Place 1 is on the far left. Click an animal (or move to it with Tab and press Enter), then click a place. Click a filled place to pick its animal up again. Press Done when every place is filled. Press Start when ready.
setting: The animals stand in a row of numbered places, from place 1 on the left to the last place on the right.

templates.left_of: The {a} is somewhere to the left of the {b}.
templates.next_left: The {a} is directly to the left of the {b}.
templates.adjacent: The {a} and the {b} are next to each other.
templates.not_adjacent: The {a} and the {b} are not next to each other.
templates.end: The {a} is either first or last in the row.
templates.not_end: The {a} is neither first nor last in the row.
templates.between: The {a} is somewhere between the {b} and the {c}.
